about.bio: shiro is a solo full-stack developer and design engineer. 19 projects shipped — 7 live applications and 12 reusable Nuxt 4 templates — spanning fintech, e-commerce, AI marketing, BPO, and service marketplaces. Full-stack across Nuxt 4/Vue 3 and Hapi.js, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, MongoDB, Supabase, SQLite, and Turso backends, with Stripe/Chapa/PayPal payments, Shopify e-commerce, OpenAI/Google Ads AI pipelines, and zero-downtime deploys on Netlify, Render, Vercel, and Heroku.
